features.title: Mengapa <brand>Perry</brand>?
features.subtitle: The current compiler, runtime, UI, and tooling surfaces — with limitations called out

noRuntime.title: No External JS Engine
noRuntime.description: Native builds run without Node.js, Bun, Deno, or an external JavaScript engine installed. The Perry runtime and garbage collector are statically linked into each target-specific binary.

fastCompilation.title: Kompilasi Cepat
fastCompilation.description: Kompilasi langsung dari TypeScript ke kode native menggunakan SWC untuk parsing dan LLVM untuk pembuatan kode yang dioptimalkan. Tanpa JavaScript perantara.

smallBinaries.title: Size Scales With Features
smallBinaries.description: Hello world can be about 330 KB and Mango is published at about 7 MB. Applications that link the full standard library or optional V8 fallback can be much larger; size depends on target, imports, and build profile.

deterministicBuilds.title: Cacheable Builds
deterministicBuilds.description: Perry caches module objects and can pin a CPU baseline for portable output. Default host builds tune for the local CPU, and final binaries may contain platform UUIDs, timestamps, or signatures, so byte-for-byte cross-machine reproducibility is not promised.

stdLib.title: Tracked Node.js APIs
stdLib.description: Native implementations cover many familiar Node.js APIs across 53 tracked modules. Coverage is broad but not complete; use perry check and the published limitations for your project.

v8Runtime.title: Paket npm Nyata
v8Runtime.description: Many pure TypeScript and JavaScript packages compile natively. Packages that depend on unsupported dynamic or engine-specific semantics may need the optional embedded V8 fallback or may not work.

widgets.title: 35+ Native UI Widgets
widgets.description: 35+ native UI widgets map to platform toolkits including AppKit, UIKit, GTK4, Win32, Android SDK APIs, SwiftUI on watches, and a DOM/CSS bridge on Web/WASM. Availability varies by target.

plugins.title: Compile-Time Plugin System
plugins.description: Modules can compose at build time and statically linked dependencies can become direct native calls. Dynamic dispatch and runtime support remain where JavaScript semantics require them.

threading.title: True Multi-Threading
threading.description: Real OS threads with parallelMap, parallelFilter, and spawn. Mutable captures are rejected by default; SharedArrayBuffer and Atomics provide explicit shared-memory coordination, with documented typed-view caveats.

i18n.title: Compile-Time i18n
i18n.description: Automatic string extraction, CLDR plural rules for 30+ locales, and compile-time validation. Translations are baked into the binary; lookup cost depends on the generated catalog and call site.

features.goDeeper: Pelajari lebih dalam: bagaimana Perry <binaryLink>mengompilasi TypeScript menjadi binary</binaryLink>, apa yang membuatnya menjadi <compilerLink>kompiler TypeScript native</compilerLink>, dan bagaimana perbandingannya dengan <electronAltLink>alternatif Electron</electronAltLink>.

internals.title: Compiler <gradient>Internals</gradient>
internals.subtitle: The key design decisions that make Perry fast

nanBoxing.p1: Perry uses a 64-bit JavaScript value representation where dynamic values can carry numbers or tagged pointer-like payloads. Representation selection can keep proved values unboxed instead of forcing every value through the generic form.
nanBoxing.p2: Numbers use IEEE 754 representation where possible; strings, objects, closures, and other heap values use tagged encodings and GC-managed storage. The compiler and runtime cooperate to preserve JavaScript semantics at dynamic boundaries.

monomorphization.p1: Generics and known call shapes can be specialized at compile time. Perry also preserves dynamic fallbacks where the receiver or value type is not proved.
monomorphization.p2: Specialization can turn known numeric and object operations into direct machine operations, but TypeScript annotations are mostly erased and do not guarantee a concrete runtime representation by themselves.

staticDispatch.p1: Known receivers can use direct calls and inlining. Unknown or dynamic receivers use runtime method dispatch, prototype lookup, and class-vtable paths.
staticDispatch.p2: This hybrid model gives LLVM static optimization opportunities without claiming that every JavaScript method call is resolved at compile time.

zeroCost.p1: TypeScript types guide compilation, while Perry still links a runtime and garbage collector to implement JavaScript semantics, async work, objects, strings, and dynamic values.
zeroCost.p2: Interfaces and many annotations erase cleanly, but classes, dynamic dispatch, allocation, and GC can have runtime costs. Perry optimizes proved cases rather than promising zero-cost abstraction universally.

internals.metaDescription: How Perry selects value representations, specializes known code, uses LLVM, and preserves runtime fallbacks for dynamic JavaScript behavior.

introducing-perry.title: Memperkenalkan Perry
introducing-perry.excerpt: Perry compiles supported TypeScript to standalone native executables with its runtime and GC linked in, without requiring an external Node.js installation or JavaScript engine.

cross-platform-native-ui.title: UI Native Lintas Platform dari TypeScript
cross-platform-native-ui.excerpt: How Perry maps one TypeScript codebase to platform widgets across its documented targets, including the platform-specific limitations and prerequisites.

building-pry.title: Membangun Pry: Penampil JSON Native dalam TypeScript
building-pry.excerpt: A walkthrough of building Pry, a native JSON viewer compiled from TypeScript to machine code with the Perry runtime and GC linked in and no webview.

plugin-systems-are-a-performance-tax.title: Sistem Plugin Adalah Pajak Performa
plugin-systems-are-a-performance-tax.excerpt: Arsitektur plugin menukar performa demi ekstensibilitas. Tapi bagaimana jika ekstensibilitas terjadi saat kompilasi bukan saat runtime? Komposisi waktu kompilasi memberikan keduanya — nol overhead, fleksibilitas penuh.

compiling-hono-trpc-strapi.title: Mengompilasi Hono, tRPC, dan Strapi ke Binary Native
compiling-hono-trpc-strapi.excerpt: Perry kini mengompilasi tiga framework TypeScript utama — Hono, tRPC, dan Strapi — menjadi executable ARM64 native. Dikompilasi dalam waktu kurang dari satu detik, menghasilkan binary di bawah 2 MB, dan berjalan tanpa crash.

all-six-platforms-ui-parity.title: Enam Platform Sekaligus, Paritas Fitur Penuh
all-six-platforms-ui-parity.excerpt: 20+ widget UI native, widget Canvas, Table view, notifikasi sistem, akses keychain, dukungan multi-window, dan paritas fitur penuh di macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Android, Linux, dan Windows — semuanya dari satu kode sumber TypeScript.

from-compiler-to-ecosystem.title: Dari Kompiler ke Ekosistem: React, Database, dan Cloud Build
from-compiler-to-ecosystem.excerpt: Perry berkembang dari kompiler menjadi ekosistem lengkap. perry/ui sebagai inti, ORM kompatibel Prisma untuk MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite, push notification universal, build terdistribusi dengan publikasi App Store, dan lapisan kompatibilitas React — semuanya dalam satu minggu.

the-full-pipeline.title: Pipeline Lengkap: Dokumentasi, Distribusi, dan WidgetKit
the-full-pipeline.excerpt: 82 commit dalam satu minggu: situs dokumentasi 49 halaman, publikasi otomatis ke App Store dan Play Store, paket Homebrew dan APT, ekstensi WidgetKit native dari TypeScript, widget baru, modul http/https, dan kompiler LLVM self-hosting.

cross-compile-windows-game-loops-and-par.title: Kompilasi Silang ke Windows, Game Loop iOS, dan 100% Paritas Pengujian
cross-compile-windows-game-loops-and-par.excerpt: 103 commit dalam satu minggu: kompilasi silang ke Windows dari Linux via lld-link, dukungan game loop iOS, pelaporan crash, pipeline build Hub dua tahap, dan kompiler self-hosting mencapai paritas pengujian deterministik 68/68.

true-multithreading-i18n-and-watchos.title: Multi-Threading Sejati, i18n Waktu Kompilasi, dan watchOS
true-multithreading-i18n-and-watchos.excerpt: Perry v0.4.0: thread OS nyata dengan keamanan waktu kompilasi, sistem internasionalisasi tanpa ribet untuk 30+ bahasa, watchOS sebagai target kompilasi ke-9, API audio dan kamera, dan pipeline kompiler paralel.

tvos-cross-compile-and-perry-login.title: tvOS, Kompilasi Silang iOS dari Linux, dan Perry Login
tvos-cross-compile-and-perry-login.excerpt: Perry v0.4.24: tvOS sebagai target kompilasi ke-10, kompilasi silang iOS dan macOS dari Linux via ld64.lld, perry login dengan penagihan berbasis penggunaan, perombakan UI Windows, notarisasi macOS, dan 120 commit dalam 5 hari.

cranelift-to-llvm.title: Dari Cranelift ke LLVM: Bagaimana Perry Menjadi 24x Lebih Cepat
cranelift-to-llvm.excerpt: Migrasi backend Perry dari Cranelift ke LLVM telah selesai. Peralihan awal membuat benchmark 70x lebih lambat — kemudian enam optimasi terarah membawa Perry meraih 14/15 kemenangan melawan Node.js, dengan percepatan hingga 24,6x.

optimizing-everything.title: Mengoptimalkan Semuanya: Satu Minggu, 68 Rilis, dan Percepatan JSON 547x
optimizing-everything.excerpt: Perry v0.5.13 → v0.5.80 dalam tujuh hari. JSON.parse menutup jarak 547x dengan Node. mimalloc hadir sebagai allocator global. Inline cache, transisi shape, slot Buffer bertipe, operasi bitwise i32-native, scalar replacement, dan event loop native yang menjaga server Fastify dan WebSocket tetap hidup.

npm-perry-dev-and-beating-bun.title: Distribusi npm, perry dev, dan Memenangkan Setiap Benchmark
npm-perry-dev-and-beating-bun.excerpt: Perry v0.5.80 → v0.5.174 dalam enam hari. @perryts/perry dirilis di npm untuk ketujuh platform yang didukung. perry dev menambahkan auto-recompile mode watch di atas cache AST in-memory dan cache objek per-modul di-disk. json_roundtrip menutup celah terakhirnya — Perry sekarang memenangkan setiap benchmark melawan Node.js dan Bun.

gen-gc-lazy-json-and-defensible-benchmar.title: GC Generasional, Lazy JSON, dan Benchmark yang Tahan Pemeriksaan
gen-gc-lazy-json-and-defensible-benchmar.excerpt: Perry v0.5.174 → v0.5.306 dalam tiga hari, plus pekerjaan GC dan JSON yang mendarat bersamanya. GC generasional kini default. Small String Optimization kini default. Pipeline JSON mendapatkan lazy tape yang mendarat di median 75 ms pada validate-and-roundtrip — terbaik di kelompok dynamic typing. Halaman benchmark ditulis ulang dengan median RUNS=11 + p95 + σ, simdjson dan AssemblyScript+json-as ditambahkan sebagai peer, dan setiap kelemahan Perry diungkap secara jujur.

updater-live-inspector-and-compiler-refa.title: Auto-Update, Inspector Live, dan Compiler yang Memotong Dirinya Sendiri
updater-live-inspector-and-compiler-refa.excerpt: Perry v0.5.306 → v0.5.359 dalam empat hari — 53 patch release, ~30 issue ditutup, dan tiga hal besar mendarat: perry/updater untuk auto-update desktop, inspector live di localhost:7676, dan refactor compiler yang menyusutkan empat file terbesar sebesar 33–91%.

closing-the-gc-gap.title: Apa yang Benchmark aya_koto Ajarkan kepada Kami tentang GC Perry
closing-the-gc-gap.excerpt: Seorang pembaca melakukan benchmark Perry pada AtCoder ABC451D dan mengukurnya 3,85× lebih lambat dari Bun. Sebuah regresi diam-diam telah memperlebar gap menjadi 6,59× sejak itu. Fix-nya tidak di tempat yang kami duga, trade-off GC disengaja yang terungkapnya nyata, dan Perry v0.5.875 sekarang seri dengan Bun di bench yang sama: 425 ms vs 431 ms.

real-npm-packages-and-a-conformance-swee.title: Paket npm Nyata Kini Ter-compile: axios, zod, express — dan Sapuan Konformansi
real-npm-packages-and-a-conformance-swee.excerpt: Sekitar 270 release dari v0.5.875 ke v0.5.1146 bukan tentang satu benchmark — melainkan tentang membuat paket npm nyata ter-compile dan berjalan. axios, zod v4, express, fastify, dan hono kini berfungsi; paritas test262 melonjak (String 60→79%, Array 61→72%); Windows menjadi Fluent dengan Mica; dan DatePicker + drag & drop mendarat di setiap platform.

shipping-a-watch-only-app-to-the-app-sto.title: Shipping a Watch-Only App to the App Store (When Nothing Else Will)
shipping-a-watch-only-app-to-the-app-sto.excerpt: Every documented way to upload a standalone watchOS app to the App Store fails — altool, iTMSTransporter, xcodebuild, even Xcode 26's Organizer all refuse the watchOS platform. Here's the undocumented workaround that works and keeps arm64_32 for older watches: an ITSWatchOnlyContainer iOS stub, uploaded with iTMSTransporter.

compiling-claude-code.title: Compiling Claude Code: One Minified Bundle, 160 Compiler Fixes
compiling-claude-code.excerpt: We pointed Perry at the 13 MB minified cli.js that npm ships for Claude Code and tried to turn it into a native binary. A month later it launches, logs in, streams a real API response, and paints what you type — and 160 pull requests had landed in Perry, from a no-op MessageChannel to a missing GC write barrier on RegExp headers.

gc-decisions-surprises.title: Membangun GC untuk compiler TypeScript native: keputusan, kejutan, dan perkembangannya
gc-decisions-surprises.excerpt: Perry mengompilasi TypeScript menjadi kode native dengan LLVM — artinya Perry memerlukan garbage collector sungguhan. Tulisan ini membahas keputusan kami, bug yang tidak meninggalkan bukti, gerbang CI yang secara struktur tidak mungkin gagal, serta posisi angkanya terhadap Node dan pesaing AOT berbasis reference counting.

items.question: Apakah Perry membutuhkan Node.js atau runtime?
items.answer: Native Perry binaries run without Node.js, Bun, Deno, or an external JavaScript engine installed. They do include the Perry runtime and garbage collector, statically linked. Packages that need engine semantics can use the optional embedded V8 fallback.

items.question: Seberapa besar binary yang dikompilasi?
items.answer: Size depends on the target, imports, and build profile. The published examples range from about 330 KB for hello world to about 7 MB for Mango; full-standard-library or optional-V8 builds can be much larger. Treat any size as a measured example, not a universal output size.

items.question: Bisakah saya menggunakan paket npm?
items.answer: Many pure TypeScript/JavaScript packages compile natively, and roughly 50 package/API implementations are tracked. Compatibility is not universal: packages using native addons, unsupported dynamic behavior, or engine-specific semantics may need the optional V8 fallback or may not work. Run perry check and consult the limitations.

items.question: Platform apa saja yang didukung Perry?
items.answer: Perry documents 11 targets: macOS, iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, tvOS, watchOS, Android, Wear OS, Windows, Linux, and Web/WASM. Web and WASM are aliases; HarmonyOS is a separate preview. Platform maturity and API coverage differ, so consult the platform guide.

items.question: Apakah Perry gratis dan open source?
items.answer: The compiler and runtime repository is MIT licensed, and local compilation requires no account. Hosted Perry Publish and commercial support are separate services; availability, limits, and pricing are confirmed in the service or in writing.

items.question: Apa bedanya Perry dengan Bun atau Deno compile?
items.answer: Bun and Deno standalone executables bundle their runtimes; Perry native builds compile through LLVM and do not embed a JavaScript engine by default, although they statically link the Perry runtime and GC. Exact size and startup comparisons are version-, platform-, and workload-specific. See the dated <bunLink>Perry vs Bun</bunLink> and <denoLink>Perry vs Deno</denoLink> pages.

items.question: Apa bedanya Perry dengan Electron atau Tauri?
items.answer: Electron ships Chromium and Node.js; Tauri uses a system webview with native-side application code. Perry instead maps its UI model to platform widgets where supported. Bundle size and platform capability vary, so use the dated <electronLink>Perry vs Electron</electronLink> and <tauriLink>Perry vs Tauri</tauriLink> comparisons rather than a universal size claim.

items.question: Seberapa matang Perry?
items.answer: Perry is pre-1.0 and changes quickly. Real projects use it today, but language, package, and platform parity are still active work. Review the <showcaseLink>showcase</showcaseLink>, current limitations, and changelog before committing a production workload.
